interpretation.evidenceScore: 0-100 source coverage / explainable evidence sufficiency, NOT community satisfaction. Capped at 65 absent game runtime proof.
interpretation.qualityScore: null until >=3 independent firsthand reports and verified exact-build game test.
interpretation.deduplication: same mod + issue + reporter + game-install context = one cluster; raw post count preserved.
interpretation.patch: surface-overlap is a retest suggestion, never proof of incompatibility.
interpretation.limitations: Selected sources, not exhaustive Discord access or statistically representative community sampling.

evidenceRecords.statement: Nexus listing reports version 5, updated October 5; public host metadata and virus-scan label are not independent game tests.
User reports missing legs, transparent bodies and incomplete portraits while describing an unofficial repacked game build.
Same user expands affected team list, without presenting a separate independent install.
Same reporter repeats missing-limbs concerns on revised roster file.
Same reporter explicitly confirms unofficial repack as the installation context; this is not a second distinct user.
One reporter says legend-team overall ratings were lowered and calls the outcome incorrect.
Author confirms intentionally lowering ratings to improve franchise balance; not a confirmation of a broken mod.
Author says missing limbs/equipment are not reproduced on their legitimate copy; no independent resolution confirmed.
A different user requests a regular-season updated roster for an unofficial repack; not a quality failure report.
Editorial writer describes SABOS Franchise 1.2 sim stats, regression, progression, retirement and injury tuning; full package still pending.
Writer describes the early 1.0 Speed Mod as ball-carrier speed tuning, not a measured benchmark.
Writer documents additional sleeves, cleats, jersey styles, tattoos and helmet removal; warns some balaclavas may not fit Madden heads.
Writer describes weekly roster, appearance, draft and franchise updates, with dependency on Unlocked.
Writer describes optional broadcast scorebugs and warns presentation mod stacking is more complex and riskier.
Writer says expansive MNF presentation and music replacement should be selected for matching game contexts.
Writer describes EJ Gameplay support for All-Pro/All-Madden and warns against stacking unrelated gameplay overhauls.
Writer recommends Buhbooh's Coach Mode/SlowSim for CPU-vs-CPU balancing.
Writer praises stadium advertising, jumbotron and ribbonboard replacements but offers no controlled current-patch benchmark.
Video demonstrates selecting a cosmetic hair-fix through MMC; video is not an independent exact-build compatibility test as of October 9.
